messages:
elly: photo dump! meet Gadget, our new guinea pig. he discovered the throw-blanket fortress and now refuses to leave. pic: https://imgur.com/a/xyz123 
jamal: omg the hammock face :heart_eyes: 
soph: absolute puff. is that a rex? he looks like a tiny tumble-saurus 
mora: did you bribe him with cucumber? :cucumber: 
elly: only with cucumber and a gentle whisper. he answered back in tiny squeaks. posted a 6s vid (gif mode) 
benji: can we have a 15-min "guinea update" on the calendar for team morale? :raised_hands: also gadget is a great name, very on-brand 
soph: quick poll — should Gadget be the official office mascot? :thumbsup: = yes, :thumbsdown: = no 
jamal: :thumbsup: 
mora: :thumbsup: 
elly: poll so far: 3/3 😅 next decision: tiny costume. options: `tiny lab coat` or `explorer hat` 
benji: lab coat. obvious vibes. 
soph: explorer hat. he has adventurer energy. 
elly: ok lab coat camp vs explorer camp — split comments please :joy: 
lunchbot: Friendly reminder: if anyone brings a live animal to the office, please fill out the pet registry and allergy checklist: https://intranet/fw/pet-policy
